title: Container High Memory Usage Alert on content-service
description: The content-service container is sitting at its memory limit: usage ~1.07 GB against a 1 Gi limit (~0% headroom) during a burst of content lookups. GC is thrashing and the container is one allocation spike away from an OOMKill. This is high-but-stable usage with a real burst profile behind it, not a crash loop.
